problem: Design a local backup procedure for a small design studio. The procedure must satisfy every requirement: (1) back up changed files automatically every night at 02:00; (2) keep 30 daily versions; (3) encrypt backups and state where encryption keys are stored; (4) maintain one off-site copy; (5) test a restore every month and state who records the result; (6) alert the studio owner on failed backups; (7) explain how staff recover an accidentally deleted file. Give a concrete action for each requirement.
